debit.sms: Send to 9223366333 from your registered mobile number — Temporary Block: TBLOCK < Space> Last four digit card number < Space> Customer ID; Permanent Block: BLOCK < Space> Last four digit card number < Space> Customer ID
debit.notes: Only published hotline is +91 22 6232 7777, a chargeable Mumbai landline that the bank's BHIM UPI page calls its '24 hours helpline'; no toll-free and no overseas numbers are published on the pages sourced here (1930 is not mentioned). Website key opens the Block Channel tool — 'Click here to block your debit card using your CIF number'. App: RBL MyBank → Manage Your Cards → Block/Unblock Card → Temporary/Permanent block → enter OTP and verify. NetBanking: Requests → Block Debit Card → select account & debit card number → reason → submit online → OTP. WhatsApp 'Hi RBL' to 8433598888 → Banking Services → 'Temporary Block my Debit Card'; chatbot RBL Cares → Menu → Banking services → Block card (temporary). Fraud email reportfraud@rbl.bank.in ('Write an email to' on the Report a Fraud page).

credit.sms: To block and request a replacement for your RBL Bank Credit Card, send BLKRBL < last two digits of your card> to 91-9223366333 from your registered mobile number.
credit.notes: Only published hotline is +91 22 6232 7777, a chargeable Mumbai landline that the bank's BHIM UPI page calls its '24 hours helpline'; no toll-free and no overseas numbers are published on the pages sourced here (1930 is not mentioned). Website key opens the Block Channel tool — 'Click here to block or reissue your credit card using your mobile number'. App: RBL MyCard App → My Account → Settings → Profile settings → Report Dispute or Fraud → Fraud → BLOCK & REPLACE/BLOCK CARD; no credit-card netbanking block path is published. WhatsApp 'Hi RBL' to 8433598888 → Credit Card Services → Switch-off Card Transaction; chatbot RBL Cares → Menu → Insta Services → Block and Reissue Credit Card. Fraud email reportfraud@rbl.bank.in ('Write an email to' on the Report a Fraud page).

upi.notes: RBL publishes no self-service UPI freeze path: the online Block Channel tool (rbl.bank.in/block-channel) covers only 'Retail Internet Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card', and its note reads 'In case you wish to block account/ any other channel please connect with us on +91 22 6232 7777 (Banking & Credit Card)' — so UPI blocking is via that 24*7 helpline. BHIM UPI runs inside the RBL MyBank app (register under BHIM UPI at dashboard, UPI IDs like name@rbl); the site publishes no in-app UPI lock/disable menu path. The BHIM UPI page: 'for further support you may call our 24 hours helpline no. +91 22 6232 7777'; unauthorized transactions can be reported 24*7 by phone or to reportfraud@rbl.bank.in from the registered email ID. UPI complaints/disputes can also be raised on the NPCI upihelp portal linked from bank pages as 'MyUPI' (upihelp.npci.org.in). USSD *99# (NUUP) from the registered mobile includes a 'UPI PIN' menu but no published UPI-freeze option.
